newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney to sell rest of Carbone stake.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney to sell rest of Carbone stake.

text.p: Pechiney said in a results statement on Thursday that the board had agreed to sell the rest of a 37 percent stake in Carbone Lorraine and that this was about 772,042 shares.
It said the sale would take place via private placement with institutional investors and that this process should start on March 10 and finish at the end of the month.
It noted in its statement that it had already sold 21 percent of Carbone to Paribas after a change of Pechiney portfolio strategy in 1995.

"Compagnie Financiere Paribas, which has 20.2 percent of the capital (of Carbone) as of December 31, 1996, has stated its intention to accompany the development of the Carbone Lorraine group in the medium term," it said.
"It reserves the option, in terms of the placement, of increasing its stake to 33 percent...by exercising preemptive rights at its disposal," the statement added.
